seoTitle: Random Line Picker: Draw Lines from a List
metaDescription: Pick one or more random lines from a pasted list, with or without repeats, using secure random numbers. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Pick one or more random lines from a pasted list, with or without repeats, using your browser secure random numbers.
why:
Choosing what to eat, who goes first or which idea to try is easier when something else decides. A random pick also avoids the bias people show when they choose.

Paste a list, set how many lines to draw and whether a line may be drawn twice. The draw uses your browser's secure random numbers without modulo bias, so every line has the same chance. Nothing is uploaded.
howTo: Paste your list, one item per line.
Set how many lines to pick.
Choose whether repeats are allowed or identical lines count once.
Press run again for a fresh draw.

faq.a: It uses crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling, so each line is equally likely.

faq.q: Can I draw the same line twice?
faq.a: Only if you tick the repeat option. Otherwise each line is drawn at most once.
No. For a repeatable, provable draw use the Giveaway Winner Picker with a seed.
